name: Merei
catalog_citation: Chung, Ying Shing Anthony. 2005. A descriptive grammar of Merei (Vanuatu). Pacific Linguistics 573. Canberra: Pacific Linguistics, RSPAS, ANU. (PDF from ANU Open Research, handle 1885/146736, via DSpace REST API)
catalog_locator: ch. 2 Phonology, sec. 2.3 Stress, p. 9 (with ch. 2 intro p. 8 and sec. 2.4 Morphophonemics pp. 9-10 for examples)
catalog_quote: 2.3 Stress. Stress is not contrastive. In two or three syllable words stress falls on the penultimate vowel except when the word final syllable is heavier than the penultimate, i.e. the final syllable has more segments than the previous syllable, in which case stress is on the final syllable; compare: (5) ma»ma.sa ‘good’ la»rai ‘grate’ In words of four or more syllables, secondary stress falls on each alternate syllable to the right of the final stressed syllable, except when the following syllable is heavier. (6) «a.bu«a.bu»ka.ra ‘quick’ ma«nai.la»rai ‘pudding’ ma«tai»ma.sa ‘sun’ ... [ch. 2 intro, p. 8:] The phonology of Merei is relatively simple, like that of other members of the Oceanic subgroup, being a non-tonal language with most syllables being simply CV syllables. ... Stress falls predicably on penultimate syllable. ... there is no contrast between short and long vowels in Mere…

audit.quote_check: confirmed in the copy we hold
audit.reasoning: The deciding quotation is verbatim in the PDF we hold at sec. 2.3, printed p. 9 (one sub-locator says ch. 2 intro p. 8; it is p. 7 — cosmetic). The source is a 2005 Pacific Linguistics descriptive grammar (74 pp., sketch-sized) by an SIL fieldworker, and it is the only description of Merei in Glottolog (Glottolog's most extensive description = this work; prior item Tryon 1976 wordlists). The classification 'weight' (penult default, final if final syllable heavier: CVV/CVC final vs CV penult; right edge; non-contrastive) matches the text exactly, including the la»rai and ma»lim examples. No competing phonology/instrumental study was found;1 (local) and the Wikipedia bibliography, both of which list only Chung 2005 as description. no reclassification or re-read needed; optionally fix the p. 8 -> p. 7 sub-locator.
